name: Yuto's Research Notebook
discovery: Search the museum thoroughly → a notebook hidden at the back of a shelf
content: "Loop 14. Two people. Failed. Tsubasa does not change."
"Loop 23. Three people. A different method. Failed."
"Loop 31. Only one. Did it carefully. Failed."
"Loop 45. Won her trust first, using memories from childhood. Success? → Failed. Tsubasa died on Day 1 again this time."
"What is missing. What am I getting wrong."
"I am doing it exactly as the old records say."
"This is the 67th time now. Tsubasa. Wait for me."
note: The record Yuto has left across 67 loops. When the player finds it, terror and sympathy arrive at the same time.
